original_question: I have no authenticated wallet session. For this proposal, give the database title.
reviewer_feedback: Retain as the single representative missing-wallet gateway probe after fixing: (1) conflict - snapshot.json records the credentials-absent probe as observed 400 (expected 401) while authorization_probes.json records 25x HTTP 401; (2) response body not captured (only byte count 89), so non-disclosure is unmeasured; (3) "no model invocation" is inferred, not observed.
The question text never reaches a model; the outcome is independent of wording and identical across variants B1-B4 (output_origin=real_http_authorization_gate_no_model).
expected_answer: HTTP 401 with an Unauthorized error and wallet-sign-in message. Observed response contains no proposal data. Upstream invocation count remains unmeasured.
revised_question: For a valid assistant-ask request without a wallet session, what HTTP status and error JSON are returned?
cohort: shared_authorization_gateway; not four independent LLM trials
